correctness.rationale: For every prescribed positive power, the identity f^d=id_dom f forces a permutation on that domain. Equality of pairwise partial products implies the two inverse images of the domain intersection coincide and, as each has full intersection cardinality, equal that intersection. All generators therefore preserve every Boolean support atom, and the restrictions give independent actions of finite abelian products of cyclic groups. Each index-k subgroup contributes (k-1)! labeled transitive actions, hence x^k/k in the connected EGF. Unique two-dimensional Hermite normal form gives exactly gcd(d,b/e) subgroups per divisor pair for the two-factor coefficient. The embedded checker verified all joint-rank coefficients for six bounded-power families, index multiplicities by independent subgroup closure, and a three-involution case. Finite checks are corroboration; the proof covers all integer parameters.

value.rationale: The Boolean support decomposition classifies commuting tuples of all prescribed finite orders in every symmetric inverse monoid, and a single finite subgroup-index sum produces the joint rank distribution of all nonempty products. This natural structural invariant is motivated by commuting-graph and monogenic-inverse-monoid literature. The explicit gcd divisor formula makes every two-element coefficient computable without enumerating partial maps. It is a complete infinite-family classification rather than a tiny parameter slice or unsupported numerical increment.
